summary: Iteration 4 tested the dashboard bypass fix, the role selector on login and signup (now with Admin), the admin_set_role SQL, Unicode PDF export, real Wikimedia images and diagram PNGs in the exports, plus regression checks. Everything I tested passed. npm test 37/37 pass, tsc has 0 errors, lint has 0 errors (4 warnings), and the HTTP suite passes 33/33 after I updated it. Signed-in flows are BLOCKED, not failed: the live DB is not migrated and the admin password is rejected. I did not retry it and wrote nothing to Supabase.

minor.issue: The schema allows up to 30 diagrams of up to 3MB each, but Vercel functions reject request bodies over about 4.5MB. A deck with several large 2x-scale PNGs will get a 413 from the platform before the route runs. Suggest checking the total payload size on the client, or lowering the scale or using JPEG for big diagrams.
Only professors and admins can call this. If GeneratedContent is shown to students (shared materials), the [IMAGE] hooks will always fall back to placeholders. Confirm this is intended.
When target_user does not exist, the function silently does nothing (UPDATE matches 0 rows). Suggest raising an error when no row is found so the UI does not show a false success toast.
If legacy rows have roles outside admin/professor/student after lower() (e.g. 'teacher'), adding the constraint will fail and abort the migration. Consider mapping those values first.

issues: Glyphs are shaped correctly, with no tofu boxes: Hindi conjuncts (प्र, क्लो, र्थ, द्रा), Bengali and Telugu all render. However, Devanagari runs sit slightly higher than Latin runs on the same line (e.g. 'क्लोरोफिल (Chlorophyll)' and 'Concept | अर्थ'). There is a baseline/ascent mismatch between fonts in createPdf run layout.
The password placeholder '••••••••' looks like a pre-filled value. Minor.
The /login?registered=1 redirect after signup shows no confirmation message on the login page. Minor.

verified: Home page / shows only the Sign In and Get Started buttons (nav-sign-in-button, nav-get-started-button). No 'Dashboard' text anywhere, desktop and mobile.

The proxy returns 307 to /login?next=<path> for /admin, /admin/users, /professor, /professor/generate, /student and /student/* without a cookie, and also with a bogus sb-*-auth-token cookie. /login, /signup and / return 200.
Opening /admin/users in the browser lands on /login?next=%2Fadmin%2Fusers with no auto-redirect.
The login role radios work: student is checked by default; clicking Admin sets aria-checked=true only on Admin. Bad credentials show the toast 'Invalid login credentials' and keep the user on /login.
Code review of the role-mismatch check: signOut runs and the toast reads 'This account does not have X access'. safeNextPath only accepts a same-origin /<role> prefix.

Signup has 3 role cards; aria-pressed toggles correctly. auth-context sends only requested_role. Nothing in app, lib or the proxy reads user_metadata or app_metadata for authorization. api-auth reads profiles.role.

SQL review found no privilege escalation. The trigger always sets role='student' and requested_role is limited to professor/admin by a CHECK. Authenticated users can only update the full_name and institution columns, so they cannot set role or requested_role themselves. admin_set_role is SECURITY DEFINER with search_path set, checks is_admin(), validates new_role, blocks self-demotion, and EXECUTE is revoked from public/anon.
Unicode PDF: export-smoke.ts runs fine and indic-page1.png renders Hindi, Bengali and Telugu correctly.
Real images: /tmp/deck.pptx has 6 pictures in ppt/media, with Wikimedia captions as slide text.

My own assets-smoke.ts confirmed images get embedded: a.docx has word/media/image1.jpg, a.pdf has 2 image XObjects, and a.pptx has a picture on the [IMAGE] slide and a diagram picture on the Mermaid slide.
Note: in the provided export-smoke.ts, the indic PDF/DOCX show '[Image: chloroplast]' because .slice(0,6) drops that query. This is a limitation of the test, not a product bug.

Mermaid in Chromium: renderMermaidPng logic run with the same config (htmlLabels false) on a Hindi/Bengali/Telugu flowchart. The SVG has no foreignObject, and canvas.toDataURL works (80KB PNG, no SecurityError).

Unauthenticated API calls return JSON 401: GET and POST /api/export, /api/images/search, documents, forms-create and generate-and-verify. Export now checks auth before validating params, so an unauthenticated request with bad params gets 401, not 400.
action_items: (Low) Guard the total size of the POST /api/export body against Vercel's 4.5MB request limit, e.g. downscale diagrams or cap the total on the client.
(Low) Fix the Devanagari/Bengali/Telugu baseline offset relative to Latin text in mixed-script PDF lines.
(Low) Make admin_set_role raise an error when the target profile is not found.
(Low) Map legacy role values before adding profiles_role_check in the migration.
(Blocked, user action) Apply supabase/migrations/20261017223000_harden_profiles_and_sync_schema.sql and reset the admin password so signed-in flows can be tested.
critical_code_review_comments: The proxy fails closed: missing env vars or an exception both lead to a redirect for protected pages. Good.
Login validates the role against profiles.role after sign-in and signs the user out on a mismatch. The role selector never grants access by itself. Good.

toBlocks (DOCX/PDF) and parseSlideDeck (PPTX) count diagrams with different regexes (split pattern vs per-slide count). They agree for standard ```mermaid\n blocks, but would drift on a fence like '```mermaid' without a newline. Consider using splitGeneratedContent in both places.
The fullName and institution inputs on signup have no data-testid.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable unauth UI; signed-in flows blocked

seed_data_creation: None. Supabase was not written to. Only one sign-in attempt, using a non-existent TEST_ email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js prod server runs on :3005 (no supervisor). Run with: python -m pytest tests/http/test_unauth_api.py (TEACH_EASY_URL defaults to localhost:3005). Mermaid scratch page is at /tmp/mm/index.html, served by python http.server on :8765. Run assets-smoke with: npx tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.json tests/live/tmp/assets-smoke.ts. Signed-in flows still need the migrated DB and working creds.
